target.trafficModel: Live TV beta cohort with normal channel zapping and catch-up attempts kept on provider media bytes.

checks.description: Provider/XUI owner confirms the QA/beta account and upstream service can support the planned 300-500 live-user beta without adding XUI-side transcode/remux.
checks.notes: Needs provider/XUI owner confirmation for the actual beta account and upstream service. Do not mark pass from local browser evidence.

checks.description: Lumen web/proxy path capacity is sized for the beta cohort and does not perform per-user media processing.
checks.notes: Needs explicit beta sizing/load evidence for the deployed Lumen web/proxy path. Current evidence proves the intended media path does not use per-user media processing, not full 300-500 user capacity.

checks.description: Browser/network/process evidence shows catch-up failures are handled with provider bytes, normalized manifests, or unsupported overlays, not ffmpeg/remux/transcode/generated HLS.
checks.notes: Manual browser/network audit captured 0 disallowed media-processing URL hits and 0 media-processing processes. Compatibility artifact has provider/no-media/gateway slices passing and device slices still pending. Runtime media policy now also proves proxy defaults do not offer remux without explicit lab override.

checks.description: Beta launch has monitored startup, playback failure, provider error, and no-media-processing signals with named owner response.
checks.notes: Needs named owner, alert route, and beta SLO response evidence before final signoff.

checks.description: Rollback or enrollment throttle plan is approved for provider overload, playback regressions, or capacity breach.
checks.notes: Needs approved rollback/throttle owner and decision path for provider overload or playback regression during beta.

signoff.notes: Partial evidence only. This artifact must not be used as final 300-500 user beta signoff until all checks are pass/fail with owners/evidence and signoff is approved.
